page.notes: The Greek word after "cùm" is printed in a small italic face and is hard to read; my reading ἐπιεικείας is doubtful and is marked [?]. The first two lines and the German words in the first line are in black letter; "verfoithalten" is uncertain and is marked as printed. The page ends mid-word "(in-" and the paragraph continues on the next page. Long s is plain s throughout. The printed "393" is taken as the page number.
